title: Flower Basket
tagline: Pick the beauty from the garden and put it in the flower basket- for storing and sharing users' knowledge system.
description:
The Flower Basket is used to help users build their own knowledge system: users can create new knowledge categories and add corresponding content to them, including text, images, videos, and website links.

All our work is based on the lens protocol: we use polygon testnet to connect the deployed lens contracts; since an account can have multiple Profile NFTs, each Profile NFT can be used as a category of user knowledge; under each Profile NFT Multiple Publications can be created, so we use Publications as the specific content of the category, including text, pictures, videos or web links, etc. Other users can follow the knowledge categories shared by others without following the author itself, so they can focus on to reframe knowledge in a field; and more...

If time permits, we also want to build more useful things: because every time we interact with the contract, we need to use the wallet to pay for gas, which makes users feel cumbersome, so we plan to build a contract that pays gas on behalf of users to help users reduce these cumbersome operation.
